subject: Mathematical Literacy

grade_alignment.status: REPOSITORY CONVENTION - not a Cambridge statement
grade_alignment.detail: Cambridge does not number school years the way this tree's grade contract does; placement is a decision each school makes. See lessons/curriculum/CAMBRIDGE/stage_alignment.json for the default pathway, the alternatives, and the unresolved A2 year.

equivalence_note: Mathematical Literacy is a South-Africa-specific NSC subject - numeracy applied to real-life contexts, taken INSTEAD of academic Mathematics. Cambridge International publishes no equivalent. Its entire Upper Secondary maths suite (0580, 0980, 0607, 0606, 0444, 4024, 4037) is academic mathematics; the Core tiers of 0580 and 0607 are grade-capped tiers of the same academic syllabus rather than a different subject in kind; and Functional Skills Mathematics, the UK numeracy-in-context qualification, is not a Cambridge International product. This folder exists so that tooling walking curriculum/{CAPS,IEB,CAMBRIDGE}/{subject} finds a uniform layout, and it records the absence explicitly rather than silently omitting the subject or forcing a false match.
consumer_rule: A Cambridge stream must NOT serve Mathematical Literacy by falling back to the CAPS or IEB tree, and must not substitute 0580 Core or 0607 Core: those are academic mathematics, and the substitution would misrepresent both qualifications to the student. Serve academic Mathematics, or serve nothing and say why.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics (Core tier)
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: A grade-capped tier of academic mathematics sharing content with Extended - a difficulty tier, not a subject of a different kind.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge IGCSE International Mathematics (Core tier)
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: Closest in spirit, since it adds modelling and real-life contexts, but still a full academic maths syllabus that feeds AS Level, and itself tiered.

caps_relationship: None. Cambridge authors its own curriculum; CAPS topic lists are NOT a valid fallback for this file.
